notes.title: Demo bugfixes v 1.5.2
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Café lovers[/b],

Thank you very much for your feedback! 
We are commited to make the best possible experience for you.

Here is the small list of fixes and changes introduced with version 1.5.2 of demo:

[list]
[*] [b]there is a new option to directly replace current coffee machine, instead of removing old one and installing new one,[/b]
[*] [b]mouse sensitiviy setting has been added,[/b]
[*] mission timer has been removed,
[*] fix for trash spawning in the middle of the counter,
[*] fix for getting stuck that some player encountered during tutorial,
[*] fix for upgrading racks: they will no longer move to the initial position.
[/list]

We would love to hear what would you like to see in the full version!
